title: Laashe Akbar Tak Mere Baba Mujeh Pohunchaayiye
body:
Laashe Akbar tak mere baba mujhe pahunchaiye
Ladkhadate hain khadam mere madad farmaiye
Le gaya meri basarat saath apne mera laal, raasat kaise karon tai aap hi farmaiye
Kaise khainchoon naujawan bete ke seene se sina, haq ata qhuwwat kare mujhko dua farmaiye
<<DIVIDER>>
Khaak-o-khoon mein bhar gayi tasweer-e-khatm ul mursaleen, aap bhi aakar zara deedar to farmaiye
Unko bhi andaaza kuch hojaye mere sabar kar, hazrat-e-ayyub ko bhi saath apne laiye
Maa khadi hain muntazar le jaon kistarha, aap hi khaime ke dar tak saath mere aaiye
Kitni hasrat se bayan karte the ye Sarwar saeed, mere baba aaiye ab aayie aajaiye
